answers.a: MuZe is a Meta AI Business Operating Server: one Discord-style server where businesses and creators run Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Threads and ads drafts in one place, with every agent action recorded like a git commit.
Meta's tools are spread across about a dozen tabs: Business Suite, Creator Studio, WhatsApp Manager, Ads Manager and more. MuZe puts them in one server with channels per surface.
Nothing is sent automatically. Agents propose; a gate called Jev hashes the exact payload, and only a human-approved, unchanged payload can reach /api/dispatch.
Every agent action shows up as a commit with author, diff and status. A commit is only marked shipped after you approve it and it is actually sent.
MuZe uses the Meta Model API with a hard spend cap, plus an optional local Llama tier and a Llama Guard 3 check before anything reaches approval. Built with Llama.
Small businesses and creators who run several brands or pages and want one inbox, one content studio and one approval queue.
In this demo nothing is connected. Products without real credentials show Not connected in the app; ads and posts are drafts only.
I'm MUSE, the voice agent of MuZe. In the app I can read your data and draft work, but I can never approve anything myself.
